records.finding: Three failures and three errors after introducing a separate durable acceptance transaction. Existing faults targeted the first COMMIT, collision tests expected both contenders at the outbox, and known-failure retries allocated new IDs.
records.resolution: Added distinct intent/final commit fault cases; target final COMMIT explicitly in original tests; assert one reserved winner and one rejected contender. Pending is explicit and cannot be bypassed; recover original requests before new work.

records.finding: One old deletion retry fixture still allocated a fresh ID behind a pending operation.
records.resolution: Recover the original deletion and retain exact projection/outbox assertions.

records.finding: A component fixture used a different Catalog identity, an old test expected partial-success return for an accepted pending write, and drift checks assumed an untyped SQL message.
records.resolution: Match the fixture authority; assert typed Pending plus original SQLSTATE and unchanged data/cache; validate recovery through the real invalidation poller. No failed operation is counted as success.

records.finding: Test compilation failed because a text replacement also changed an unrelated assertion to reference originalId outside its method.
records.resolution: Restore the unrelated normal incremental-sync assertion and retain receipt verification only in the recovery scenario. 65 completed tests in that run were retained as evidence, not misreported as a passing run.

records.finding: One 121-character API Javadoc line exceeded the unchanged 120-character rule.
records.resolution: Wrapped documentation; api-analysis2 formal verify passed.

records.finding: Two new JDBC SQL-construction findings in SyncCompletionRows; current Indexing API still reported nine existing findings.
records.resolution: Replace closed-enum runtime table-name concatenation with compile-time SQL constants and exhaustive selection. Do not suppress either SQL finding. Indexing findings remain separately open.

records.finding: Full Provider dependency-closure static verify stopped at the nine Indexing API findings before its own tests.
records.resolution: Record the failure; build/install current reactor dependencies and run a scoped Provider verify. This does not replace or pass the failed whole-closure gate.

records.finding: 56 behavior tests passed; Checkstyle found 13 issues (switch formatting, parameter positions 11/12 and constructor separators).
records.resolution: Use a local exhaustive SQL selection, name JDBC parameter indices, and fix whitespace. Three additional existing overlong declarations/Javadoc lines were wrapped without behavior changes.

records.finding: The named SQL parameter made one serialization statement 125 characters.
records.resolution: Wrapped it; provider-style2 passed, then provider-isolated2 passed formal verify with 56 tests.

records.finding: Initial new validation rejected blank identifiers although the existing domain/storage contract only required non-null strings.
records.resolution: Restrict backend validation to unrepresentable NUL/overlong identifiers; preserve domain naming semantics. Regression covers storable empty/whitespace names and 255 supplementary Unicode code points.

records.finding: An evidence helper assumed static XML reports survived subsequent clean builds; the file lookup failed.
records.resolution: Retain actual terminal verify results and unchanged source hashes; explicitly record lost XML, regenerate current packaged-source reports with static-reports, and capture those separately. No prior-batch passing report substituted.

test_policy: No disabled tests, no lowered gate thresholds, no new SpotBugs exclusion. All latest selected testcase reports pass.
